name: Enterprise Offering Portfolio Scope and Landscape
constraints: Offering Portfolio Scope is a versioned governance filter and Offering Landscape is a read-only reproducible projection; neither mints a business identity.
Product, Service, Offering, Quote and Entitlement remain distinct masters.
Membership derives from versioned market, channel, availability and policy predicates and a declared as-of time.
Comparison basis, criterion set, units, windows, sources and class-specific adjustments are explicit.
Zero revenue never means zero value and missing price never means free.
Duplicate-outcome claims require intended-outcome, consumer, entitlement and substitution evidence; name similarity is insufficient.
Offering retirement never cancels quotes, order lines, subscriptions, contracts, obligations or entitlements.
Every released view pins scope, scenario, horizon, source revisions and a reproducible fingerprint.
holds: Product Catalogue, Offering Catalogue and Consumption Entitlement remain identifier-unassigned in their owning contours.
WM-ACT-004 publication semantics and relationship contracts require reconciliation.
Independent Grok review, crosswalks, immutable pins and frozen audit remain pending.
